title: The Moon in the Day
text: One morning {{name}} looked up at the sky. The sun was bright and warm. But there was the moon too! "The moon is out in the day!" {{name}} said. {{name}} felt very curious. "Why is the moon here now?" Dad came to look. "The moon is always there," said Dad. "Sometimes we see it in the day." {{name}} watched the moon all day long. The sun was big and gold. The moon was small and gray. {{name}} drew a picture of them. After lunch the moon was still there. "Hello, little moon," {{name}} said with a smile. Soon the evening came. The sun went down slow. Now the moon was bright and white. The stars came out, one by one. {{name}} looked up and felt glad. The moon was a friend all day.
